title: Upstream: /notify must come from the room's hub
description: Gap in draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-06 §5.5 (Fanout Messages and Room Events): POST /notify/{roomId} is described as the hub's fanout path, but nothing says a receiving provider MUST accept /notify for a room only from that room's hub, nor how a follower identifies the hub. Every example uses the roomId authority as the hub (POST /notify/a.example/r/clubhouse from a.example), and §5.4.1.3 franking checks 'the domain of the Hub', which presupposes it. Without the rule any participating provider can inject Commits/Welcomes for a room it does not host. Related: #150 (hub credential identity), #153 (FanoutMessage lacks room URI). TODO (needs Mark's explicit go for each upstream write): file an issue on ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol, then a PR adding to §5.5 that the hub is the provider named by the room ID's authority and a provider MUST reject /notify from any other sender; ask the authors whether hub transfer is intended (which would break authority=hub). Downstream: crate-jmap JMAP-6k5d.11 and draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 adopt the authority rule (option A, Mark 2026-10-21).
close_reason: 2026-10-22 with Mark's go: issue ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol#179, PR #180 (fork branch MarkAtwood:notify-from-hub, commit 6bfefc3), list post to mimi@ietf.org from mark@reviewcommit.com ('draft-ietf-mimi-protocol: who may send /notify for a room? (hub transfer question)'). Hub-transfer question asked in issue and on list; watch for replies.
